description: This file defines the class TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system's PIM module, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewTerminationReasons'.

classes.name: TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements menu configuration for termination reasons, setting the active screen to 'viewTerminationReasons' within the PIM module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewTerminationReasons' for the PIM module. Implements the interface method from MenuConfigurator.
